source.subject: s0236
source.access: HTTP range extraction of 13 mask members from the Zenodo zip; no CT image volume downloaded, nothing derived from greyscale
source.consequence: every vessel on this page and the wall/lumen split are CONSTRUCTED; the serosal contour, the oesophago-gastric and pyloro-duodenal junctions, the fundus boundary and the neighbouring organ surfaces are MEASURED on this subject's own labels

fasted_volume_mL: fasted human gastric content volume, MRI; the organ wall is collapsed
wall_thickness_mm: normal gastric wall on CT when the stomach is distended (<=5 mm)
cardia_mucosa_mm: histological cardiac mucosa extent, mean 5 mm (Am J Surg Pathol 2002;26:1207, via PathologyOutlines)
mucosa_thickness_body_mm: gastric body mucosal thickness; foveolar compartment 0.2 mm, glandular 0.6 mm, foveola:gland 1:4 (normal values tabulated in Gastroenterology 1993;104:1310, Menetrier series)
mucosa_thickness_antrum_mm: gastric antral mucosal thickness, foveolar compartment 0.4 mm (same source)

measured.volume_state: between the fasted range and the postprandial capacity range — this CT was not acquired in a declared fasted state, so neither range is a pass/fail test; both are reported
measured.outline_arc_definition: textbook definition: the gastric label is projected into its own C-plane, the outline is split at the projected oesophago-gastric junction and pylorus, and the two arcs are measured.  Projection flattens the organ, so both numbers are LOWER BOUNDS on the true 3-D arc lengths.
measured.curvature_trace_definition: per-centreline-station extreme surface voxels along the in-C-plane normal, then Laplacian-smoothed and resampled at 2 mm; the longer trace is labelled greater curvature (a result, not an assumption). The pre-smoothing lengths are reported too, because per-voxel traces overestimate arc length.
measured.coeliac_origin_anchored_to: aorta surface at this subject's T12 level

reference: normal gastric wall on CT when the stomach is distended (<=5 mm)
wall_thickness_mm.note: the label has no wall/lumen distinction; this is a published distended-CT value, NOT measured on this subject

cardia_collar_half_width_mm.note: endoscopic/surgical cardia collar measured along the centreline from the MEASURED oesophago-gastric junction; the histological cardiac mucosa is only 1-15 mm (mean 5 mm)
reference: histological cardiac mucosa extent, mean 5 mm (Am J Surg Pathol 2002;26:1207, via PathologyOutlines)

rugae.note: longitudinal mucosal folds, displaced inward as A*(0.5+0.5*cos(N*theta)) about the measured centreline and faded to zero through the antrum and pyloric canal; normal distended gastric folds are < 5 mm

body_antrum_boundary.from: measured curvature maximum on this subject's lesser curvature

fundus_boundary.from: horizontal plane through the MEASURED cardiac orifice (standard anatomical definition applied to this subject)

criteria: stomach label present and is one dominant connected component (largest component >= 95% of label volume)
label does not touch the field-of-view edge
label volume between the fasted lower bound and the published capacity upper bound (25-1500 mL)
a measurable oesophago-gastric contact band exists (cardia anchor)
a measurable pyloro-duodenal contact band exists (pylorus anchor)
both great-vessel anchors present: aorta and portal_vein_and_splenic_vein labels non-empty
